SELECT DISTINCT
  r.name_with_owner AS repository_name_with_owner,
  r.host_type AS hosting_platform,
  r.size * 1024 AS size_in_bytes,
  r.language AS primary_language,
  r.fork_source_name_with_owner AS fork_source_name,
  r.updated_timestamp AS last_update_timestamp,
  ft.artifact_name,
  ft.library_name,
  ft.languages AS library_languages
FROM `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.dependencies` d
JOIN feature_toggle_libs ft ON d.dependency_name = ft.artifact_name AND d.dependency_platform = ft.platform
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects` p ON d.project_id = p.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.repositories` r ON p.repository_id = r.id
ORDER BY r.name_with_owner, ft.artifact_name
